title: Interval-certified off-grid continuum residual (C4 orbit)
method: Per-mode mpmath interval evaluation (dps=40); no power recurrence, no float64 fallback, no ulp-margin approximation
note: Replaces the previous float64+ulp-margin version. Each Fourier mode is evaluated independently via mpmath interval exp/cos/sin, avoiding the power-recurrence width amplification that affected the naive approach.
